rules.title: Himachal entry toll for vehicles from other states
rules.detail: Charged at entry barriers under the yearly toll policy. Notified rates name passenger and goods vehicles only. The Chief Minister said two-wheelers stay exempt. The policy document was not opened.

season.note: Jalori Pass has no fixed closing order; it shuts whenever snow falls between December and March and reopens when the highway authority clears it.

gaps: Himachal entry toll: the two-wheeler exemption rests on a newspaper report of the Chief Minister's statement (26 March 2026). The official Toll Policy 2026-27 document on hptax.gov.in failed to open (certificate error), so it is not confirmed for motorcycles registered in other states.
Jalori Pass altitude: a local blog gives 3,120 metres; newspapers give 10,280 feet and 10,800 feet. No official figure found.
No closing or reopening dates found for the winters of 2020-21, 2021-22 and 2022-23.
No source found for rules in the Tirthan valley, including any entry fee for the Great Himalayan National Park.
The hours of the November 2025 heavy vehicle restriction sit in a document attached to the district notice, which was not opened.
No source found on whether any office sets timings for two-wheelers on the pass.
Videos: titles and channels were read from the video pages; filming dates and motorcycles are not confirmed.
